markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [3 max]. Modern programming languages use Unicode; Which can encode 216 (about 64,000) characters; Compared to ASCII which only uses 8 bits; Which includes special characters from different alphabets/languages/character sets; Allowing these programming languages to be used by people from different parts of the world (only award this marking point if a correct reason has already been given);
source_issues: Source MS incorrectly limitsUnicode to2^16 and describesASCII as8-bit; not copied.
